name: nRF51822 (Speaker Controller)
description: Nordic nRF51822 BLE SoC used as the speaker's button/encoder/LED controller
notes: Nordic nRF51822 BLE microcontroller flashed with custom firmware (via OpenOCD + ST-Link V2). Maps the speaker's physical controls to GPIO lines read by the Raspberry Pi Zero W. P0.0 and P0.04 idle HIGH; the encoder lines and LED2 idle LOW. P0.29 (LED1) and the P0.13/P0.14 UART are not wired to the Pi in this build.
